turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5214. The email is kaelis.draganut@example.com.
Îmi pare rău, dar nu mai poți returna acest print: perioada de 14 zile de la livrare s-a încheiat. Nu am înregistrat o cerere de retur.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: It was delivered earlier this month. The colour is not what I expected.

I understand the colour wasn’t what you expected. The return policy allows catalogue prints to be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the policy check for this order says that window has closed, so I can’t file a return request.
I can pay the postage. Please file the return anyway.
I can’t file the return because the policy check says the 14-day return window for this order has closed. Paying the return postage doesn’t change that.
